ValidationRule.description: Si el campo Missed Reason tiene valor "Texto Abierto" debe cumplimentarse el campo "Other Reason"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( DES_Missed_reason__c,'Texto Abierto'), ISBLANK( DES_Other_missed_reason__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sorry, you can't do this yet. To move forward in a opportunity, please make sure that you have filled out the following fields: Other missed reason
